outcomes.outcome: commush.sh is installed in <localdir>/bin, root:root 0755, as the module ships it
in a clone, a confirmed run commits the tracked changes (not untracked files) as the given name and email with the typed message and pushes them to origin's branch, master when none is given
declining the confirmation commits and pushes nothing; a missing email prints the usage and exits 1
a branch argument other than the current branch prints an error and the run goes on (the baseline's guard does not stop)
an https remote with a token prompt

uncovered.why: the https URL and the token prompt belong to git and the deployment's server, not to the script, whose commands are the same against any remote (the set pushes to a local origin)
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: an https git server in the lab that asks for a token
uncovered.evidence: nodes.yml (2026-11-23): no node kind has a git server capability, and no class of the repository installs one; the script's git commands are tested against the local origin by this set's checks
